data.action: 一手拉开战斗紧身衣前襟拉链，另一手扶住长凳，转头看向视角
data.description: 【飞鸟马时 · C&C更衣室半脱】激战归来的更衣室内，时侧身面向你解开战斗紧身衣前襟的拉链，金发披散在光滑白皙的后背与腰窝间。面对你的视线，她平静地回过头，蓝眸里带着全然的信赖——「主人，装备维护需要褪下紧身内衬……在主人面前，时没有任何需要隐藏的秘密。」
data.promptProse: Turning toward the viewer in a front three-quarter view, she lowers the front zipper with one hand and steadies herself on the bench with the other. Cold locker-room light reaches the open suit and metal lockers.
data.title: 飞鸟马时 · C&C更衣室半脱
data.identityProseOverride: Asuma Toki from Blue Archive, with loose blonde hair, blue eyes and a halo.
data.animaCaption: One hand lowers the front zipper while the other steadies her on the bench.
